title: Jonah Prays from the Fish
summary: Jonah prayed from inside the fish and God heard him. We can pray to God from the deepest trouble. When you are stuck because of a bad choice, Jonah's prayer shows that turning back to God can begin in the mess.

read_it.prompt: Read Jonah 2:1-10 like a scene you could retell: who is there, what happens, and what changes?

tell_it: Jonah prayed from inside the fish and God heard him. Jonah prayed from inside the fish. He remembered the Lord and thanked Him for rescue. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: Jonah Prays from the Fish should not be flattened into a slogan. We can pray to God from the deepest trouble. When you are stuck because of a bad choice, Jonah's prayer shows that turning back to God can begin in the mess.
age_5_7_explanation: Jonah prayed from inside the fish and God heard him.
age_8_11_explanation: Jonah prayed from inside the fish. He remembered the Lord and thanked Him for rescue. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble.
